designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1974 when the Department of the Interior placed Howland Island under the Fish and Wildlife Service as a national wildlife refuge.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Howland Island National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1974 and includes 410,999 acres, of which 648 acres are terrestrial and 410,351 acres are submerged.
